title: Quarterly private deployment cadence: initiative backlog, OKR synchronization, and telemetry gates
creator: Priya Patel
body:
Summary:
This ticket defines a repeatable quarterly cadence for planning, tracking, and releasing Private/VPC/on-prem features. The emphasis is synchronizing initiative-level OKRs to engineering sprints, creating measurable telemetry gates for rollouts, and ensuring cross-functional dependencies (security, infra, legal) are explicit against every initiative. The deliverable is a lightweight playbook + backlog slice for the quarter, a tracked list of gating metrics for each wave, and a published schedule with contingency lanes.

Context and motivation:
- We have many enterprise customers requesting predictable Private/VPC releases. Current sequence is ad-hoc: feature readiness, then manual coordination for security review and infra provisioning. That creates misalignment between product goals and operational readiness.
- We need a standard cadence that ties OKRs -> initiative hypotheses -> sprint-level work -> telemetry gates and rollback criteria so PMs, Eng, Security, and Customer Success can plan capacity and customer cohorts.

Goals for the quarter:
1) Define and publish the quarterly cadence document that all teams adopt for Private/VPC initiatives.
2) Create a backlog slice (priority-ordered) covering the top 6 initiatives for Private (RBAC, KMS integrations, upgrade-runbook automation, VPC peering UX improvements, tenant analytics, on-prem packaging).
3) For each initiative, define 3 telemetry gates (smoke, safety, quality) with ownership and alerting hooks.
4) Align OKRs: map initiative outcomes to two corporate OKRs (Adoption and Reliability) and translate into measurable targets.
5) Run a pilot wave with 2 customers in Cycle 12 and document lessons.

Scope and non-goals:
- Scope: Roadmap planning cadence, gating telemetry definitions, backlog prioritization, stakeholder RACI, and pilot execution plan.
- Non-goal: Implementing all engineering work for initiatives; this ticket hands off discrete ENG tickets for execution.

Stakeholders and reviewers:
- PMs: Priya Patel (owner), Jonas Mendez (enterprise PM)
- Engineering leads: Marcus Li (assignee), Aya Nakamura (runtime), Tomas Schmidt (infra)
- Security: Laila Kumar
- Customer Success: Diego Alvarez
- Legal/Compliance: Hannah Cole

Deliverables:
- A published cadence playbook (Confluence) with calendar templates and acceptance gates
- Backlog slice (Linear epic links) with prioritization rationale and estimates
- Telemetry gate catalog (CSV + console dashboard links) and alert definitions
- Pilot plan and two customer cohorts identified with roll-out windows and rollback criteria

Risks and mitigations:
- Risk: Gate thresholds too strict or too loose -> mitigation: start with conservative thresholds and iterate after pilot, include a safety rollback runbook.
- Risk: Cross-team bandwidth mismatch -> mitigation: front-load security and infra scoping in planning week and reserve one implementation sprint for integration.
- Risk: Customers require non-standard network topologies -> mitigation: classify custom topologies and map to a support path (S1,S2,S3) and document expected lead times.

Metrics and OKR mapping:
- OKR A (Adoption): Increase Private tenant activations by 30% quarter-over-quarter. Measurement: new activated tenants / quarter (target 24).
- OKR B (Reliability): Achieve <1% deployment failures during pilot waves and MTTR <45 minutes for rollout incidents. Measurement: rollout failure rate and incident MTTR.
- Initiative-level telemetry examples: RBAC rollout success rate (>=95%), KMS integration encryption verification pass rate (100% for configured tenants), Upgrade-runbook automated steps executed without human intervention (>=80%).
acceptance_criteria: Cadence playbook published to Confluence and announced in cross-functional channel
Backlog slice with prioritized initiatives and estimates is present in Linear and linked from the playbook
Each initiative has 3 telemetry gates defined (smoke, safety, quality) with owner and dashboard link
Pilot cohort customers identified and signed off by Customer Success
Pilot runbook and rollback procedure peer-reviewed by Security and Infra
OKR mapping sheet submitted showing target metrics and measurement queries
tasks: PM: Draft playbook and calendar templates (Priya)
Eng: Scope infra and network dependencies for top 3 initiatives (Marcus, Aya)
Security: Define review checklist and required evidence for KMS/RBAC (Laila)
CS: Identify pilot customers and prepare onboarding plan (Diego)
Data: Create dashboard queries for gate metrics and alerting (Data team)
Legal: Review pilot customer contract addenda if needed (Hannah)

2025-01-22 Laila Kumar: Security checklist updated; KMS key rotation scenario added. Recommend including HSM compatibility test in pilot.
2025-01-29 Jonas Mendez: Suggested prioritization change: move tenant analytics to Q2 to keep pilot scope tight. Agreed with PM/Eng.
2025-02-03 Diego Alvarez: Two pilot candidates confirmed (AcmeCorp, HealthSync). Both require specific SLA language; legal loop opened.
2025-02-05 Priya Patel: Updated playbook with pilot windows and telemetry gate templates. Marking high-priority for cross-team kickoff next week.
